name: Gérardmer Film Festival
blurb: France's leading genre-film festival in the Vosges, showcasing fantasy, horror and thriller cinema with juries and masterclasses.

editions.evidence: jds.fr festival listing (via WebFetch): dates 'Du 26/01/2027 au 31/01/2027', billed as the '34e édition'.

notes: The official site redirects to a '/2027/' minisite (nav already has an 'Edition 2027' link) but currently shows only recap photos and an open call for films from the January 2026 (33rd) edition, plus a 2026 palmarès; no jury, guests or exact dates are posted there yet, so the 2027 dates above come from a secondary listing (jds.fr) rather than the festival's own copy — worth re-checking against the official site closer to the date. Cover uses the 2027-branded logo (file name 'LogoGerardmerFRA27') since the homepage's visible photos are recap images explicitly credited to the 2026 edition ('XGE26').
